subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Hello Team, I hope this email finds you well. I am excited to announce that our annual team building event is coming up next month. This year, we are planning a fun day out at the local adventure park followed by a team dinner. We believe this event will help strengthen our bonds and boost team morale. Please let me know if you have any dietary restrictions or special requests. Looking forward to a great day together! Best regards, [Your Name]
